create_feature_spec: create a FeatureSpec to serialize numpy arrays to bytes for dataset storage
encode_tf_example: encode a row of numpy data into a serialized TF Example proto with optional compression
decode_tf_example: decode a serialized TF Example proto string back into a nested dictionary of numpy arrays
prefetch_iterable: prefetch elements from an iterable in a background thread with a configurable buffer size
transform_learner_input: transform raw observation data into a StreamDict usable by the AlphaStar learner
